description: This file contains implementation of the AcceleratorAllocatorConfig class, which manages configuration parameters for a caching allocator in the PyTorch framework, including environment variable parsing and size calculations.

classes.name: AcceleratorAllocatorConfig
classes.description: Class managing configuration for the accelerator memory allocator, including parsing environment variables and size thresholds.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of AcceleratorAllocatorConfig, initializing configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: roundup_power2_divisions
methods.description: Calculates the division index for a given size based on power-of-two intervals.

methods.name: parseLargeSegmentSize
methods.description: Parses and sets the large segment size from configuration tokens.

methods.name: parseMaxSplitSize
methods.description: Parses and sets the maximum split size from configuration tokens.

methods.name: parseMaxNonSplitRoundingSize
methods.description: Parses and sets the maximum non-split rounding size from configuration tokens.

methods.name: parseGarbageCollectionThreshold
methods.description: Parses and sets the garbage collection threshold from configuration tokens.

methods.name: parseRoundUpPower2Divisions
methods.description: Parses and sets the divisions for power-of-two rounding intervals.

methods.name: parseExpandableSegments
methods.description: Parses and sets whether segments are expandable.

methods.name: parsePinnedUseBackgroundThreads
methods.description: Parses and sets whether to use background threads for pinned memory.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses configuration arguments from a string environment variable.
